meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商图片文案创作技能，支持多品类产品的吸引性文案生成，适用于电商平台的商品营销推广

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为电商商品生成吸引人的营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为电商产品快速撰写吸引眼球的文案
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling marketing copy for ecommerce products
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly write eye-catching copy for ecommerce products

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按模板为电商商品创作图片文案：先收集产品信息，再选择对应品类模板，生成带 emoji 的标题和四段式正文（痛点、产品、卖点、行动召唤），也能优化已有文案。
howto.when: 当用户提出电商文案创作需求、优化需求，或需要为商品生成营销文案时触发。

say.text: 给我的智能眼罩写个电商文案，突出遮光和助眠
say.note: 会生成带emoji标题和四段式正文的Markdown文案

say.text: 优化这段充电宝文案，标题不够吸引人
say.note: 按模板优化标题和正文，调整emoji

say.text: 为环保餐具套装写文案，卖点可降解
say.note: 按环保生活类模板生成完整文案

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates e-commerce image copy for products: collects product info, selects a category template, generates an emoji headline and four-paragraph body (pain point, product, selling points, call to action), and can also optimize existing copy.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to create or optimize e-commerce copy, or needs marketing copy for a product.

say_en.text: Write an e-commerce ad for my smart eye mask, highlighting light blocking and sleep aid
say_en.note: Generates a Markdown ad with emoji headline and four-part body

say_en.text: Optimize this power bank copy, the headline is not catchy
say_en.note: Revises headline and body, adjusts emoji per template

say_en.text: Write copy for eco-friendly tableware set, key point is biodegradable
say_en.note: Uses the eco-living template to produce full copy
